title: Jerome T. Murphy Professor of the Practice
bio: Shawn Ginwright‘s work focuses on trauma, healing, and empowering African American youth. His research and introduction of the concept of "healing-centered engagement" has been instrumental in reshaping the discourse surrounding youth development.
research_interests: With deep expertise that connects research
